items.title: Approval and Adoption of the Minutes
Approval and Adoption of the Minutes
Mayor's County Council Report
notes: Mayor Watters indicated the Grand River Conservation Authority is currently undergoing significant changes related to new Provincial regulations and they will be attending local Council meetings to provide an update. He also indicated the GRCA is reviewing membership policies.

items.title: Councillor's Committee Updates
notes: Members of Council provided updates on the ongoing committee and local board activities.

items.title: Hugh Handy, GSP Group and Cheryl Shindruk, Geranium re: item 8.2
notes: Decision Report RZ06/22 (Fergus Golf Course)

Cheryl Shindruk, Geranium, appeared in support of the staff report and indicated their commitment to the well monitoring program and the municipal responsibility agreement, and is sensitive to the surrounding active agricultural operations and have agreed to a tree buffer and a chain link fence.

items.title: Five Bridges in former Pilkington Township Municipal Class
notes: Environmental Assessment Study - Notice of Study Commencement Report from A. Dickieson, Engineering Services Coordinator Adam Dickieson, Engineering Services Coordinator provided an overview of the project and introduced Andrew Dawson from RJ Burnside & Associates.

Andrew Dawson, RJ Burnside & Associates introduced the project team, and highlighted the project study area, the characteristics of each bridge, the municipal class environmental assessment process, the various options under consideration, the evaluation criteria and the project timeline.
Staff responded to questions regarding possible diversion of the waterway and timing for feedback that aligns with the agricultural community.

items.title: Decision Report RZ06/22 (Fergus Golf Club)
notes: Report from B. Salmon, Managing Director of Planning and Development B. Salmon, Managing Director of Planning and Development provided an overview of the report and responded to questions related to the well monitoring program, the communal water system responsibility agreement, environmental protection, details concerning the buffer and fencing barrier, the functionality of the new storm water management system with the abandonment of the Black Drain, and dust control measures during construction.
